otherDetail: Other income of $41M, net — mostly interest earned on Datadog's $4.1B of cash and marketable securities.

segments.name: Platform subscriptions
segments.note: One integrated platform — monitoring, security and AI observability, priced per host and per feature. Datadog reports a single revenue stream.

takeaways.text: Revenue grew 28% to $886M, and customers spending $100k+ a year rose 16% to about 4,060 — big companies keep putting more of their systems on Datadog.
takeaways.title: Growth held strong

takeaways.text: GAAP operating loss was $6M (a -1% margin); non-GAAP operating income was $207M (23%). Almost the entire gap is $201M of stock-based compensation — pay delivered in shares rather than cash.
takeaways.title: Two operating profits

takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $214M in one quarter — 24 cents per revenue dollar — and Datadog ended the quarter with $4.1B of cash and marketable securities.
takeaways.title: Cash keeps piling up

verdict: Datadog grew revenue 28% to $886M and stayed net-profitable at $34M, but its core operations lost $6M on a GAAP basis — $201M of stock pay is the whole gap to its $207M non-GAAP operating profit.
